captions.text: Hey, do you even know who I am?
I don't actually know who's speaking unless you tell me. Ah. Are you Vivek or Alex?
Hey, can you move your shared screen yourself, or does someone else have to do that?
Only the coding session can move or scroll the shared screen. I can point at things on it, but I cannot move it myself.
